function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate the standard deviation for a null hypothesis test? Actually they give sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, and population mean 98.6. They want to compute the p-value? The question: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" might mean "standard deviation for the null hypothesis test"? Actually maybe they want to compute the standard error? Or compute the t-statistic? The phrase "以得到人口平均值為98.6" means "to get the population mean of 98.6". So they want to test H0: μ = 98.6 vs H1: μ ≠ 98.6. They have sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, n=40. They want to compute the p-value? The user says "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" Actually "標準差" might refer to "standard error" or "standard deviation of the sampling distribution"? They might want to compute the standard error of the mean: SE = s / sqrt(n) = 1.4 / sqrt(40). That equals 1.4 / 6.3249 = 0.2215. Then compute t-statistic: (98.2 - 98.6) / SE = -0.4 / 0.2215 = -1.805. Then compute p-value two-tailed: 2 * P(T > |t|) with df = n-1 = 39. Using t distribution. Let's approximate: t = -1.805, df=39. The two-tailed p-value ~ 0.078? Let's approximate using t distribution table: For df=40, t=1.68 gives p=0.10, t=2.02 gives p=0.05. So t=1.805 gives p between 0.10 and 0.05, maybe ~0.08. So p-value ~0.08. So we fail to reject at alpha=0.05. So answer: Standard error ~0.2215, t-statistic ~-1.805, p-value ~0.08. Provide explanation. Use the function to compute p-value. Let's call the function.
